newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan CPI up 0.5 percent in November.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan CPI up 0.5 percent in November.

text.p: Morocco's consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.5 percent to 148.1 in November from 147.4 the previous month, an official report said on Sunday.
The Statistics Directorate attributed the increase to a rise in food costs, up 0.7 percent, and transport and communications rising 0.6 percent.
The average rise for the CPI in the first 11 months of the year was 2.9 percent higher than the same period in 1995.
The base year for the index set at 100 points is 1989.
The wholesale price index (WPI) rose 0.4 percent to 357.4 in November against 356.2 in October, said the report carried by the official news agency MAP.
For the first 11 months of 1996 the average index rose 4.9 percent compared with the same period in 1995.
